title: Oval Combination Shower Basket, 18-3/4-Inch, Solid Brass, Wall Mount - Baskets Collection, Allied Brass
body_html:
Stop balancing bottles on the edge of the tub—this oval, wall-mounted shower basket keeps your daily shower essentials organized and right where you need them.

  • Keep shower items contained with an 18-3/4-inch oval basket sized for everyday bottles and bars.
  • Maintain a clean, finished appearance with concealed screw mounting hardware.
  • Built for wet areas with solid brass construction and rust proof solid brass wires.
  • Coordinate a cohesive look with the Baskets collection—ideal for transitional bathroom hardware and versatile bath accessories.
  • Match your décor with multiple designer finish options available.

  • Product type: Oval combination shower basket
  • Material: Brass
  • Mounting: Wall mount (concealed screw mounting system)
  • Dimensions (L x H x W): 18.75 x 2.25 x 4.13 in

  • Weight: 4.8 lb
  • Included: Basket and all installation hardware
  • Assembly required: No
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
